title: TH07 official trial 0.11, Normal Reimu A, physical Momentum, default opening 2 spare and 3 Bombs
selection: Fixed lowest optimizer seed; both actors identical ancestor and draws except effect of positional loss
acquisition: 6 pairs minimum, expand one paired seed at a time in frozen order until each arm reaches 30000 actual Stage 1 native ticks; cap 12 valid pairs. Two technical replacements per arm max. Keep all rejected data, including trace and reason. Base arm first for second lane on first seed, alternate within lane.
clock: All decision observations on exact native ticks divisible by 4; t+1..t+4 planned consumed action; check saved original .rpy keys and live key/tick samples. Initial difference zero; subsequent image difference previous observed tick. Exact 4-tick interval in >=99.5% windows per credit, no completely stale middle decision. Report all missing and mismatches including boundaries; tag unplayed terminal residue.
endpoint: Genuine original terminal only, independently verify official stage slots, scorecard, three stock losses where applicable, zero Continue; retain early rows and terminal stock; counts of actual Bomb activations independently read from final original result. Capture full video for both arms on first held seed.
primary: Sum native Stage 1 deaths / sum Stage 1 native ticks and individually reported first-stage progress. Promotion RR<=0.75 and progress no worse; RR>=1.0 stop this intervention. Controller RNG matched within pair; original in-game RNG uncontrolled. Descriptive interpretation.
secondary: Stage2 reaching, deaths with pre-hit Bombs >0, actual successful Bombs, native spares/Bombs at entry/exit including any unreadable stock and first-miss tick, original score.
